Get exposure category statistics from a Stanfit object or Stanfit input

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-stanfit-methods.R
get_exposure_category_statistics.Rd

Extracts or computes exposure category statistics (n, mean, cov, css, uss) from an IdealAdaptorStanfitInput, MVBU_Stanfit, or MVBU_StanfitPosterior object.

Usage

get_exposure_category_statistics(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  stats = c("n", "mean", "cov", "css", "uss"),
  simplify = TRUE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <IdealAdaptorStanfitInput>/<MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_exposure_category_statistics(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  stats = c("n", "mean", "cov", "css", "uss"),
  simplify = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An IdealAdaptorStanfitInput, MVBU_Stanfit, or MVBU_StanfitPosterior object.

categories

Optional character vector of category names. Default: NULL.

groups

Optional character vector of group names. Default: NULL.

stats

Character vector of statistics to return. Allowed values are "n", "mean", "cov", "css", and "uss". Default: c("n", "mean", "cov", "css", "uss").

simplify

Logical. If TRUE (default) and the query matches a single category, group, and statistic, returns an atomic vector or matrix. If FALSE, always returns a tibble.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

Value

If simplify = TRUE and a single statistic is selected for a single category and group, the atomic numeric value, vector, or matrix. Otherwise, a tibble with the grouping columns and requested statistics.

See also

get_sufficient_category_statistics

Examples

sfi <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input()
get_exposure_category_statistics(sfi, stats = "mean")
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>   group         category mean     
#>   <fct>         <fct>    <list>   
#> 1 left_shifted  /d/      <dbl [1]>
#> 2 right_shifted /d/      <dbl [1]>
#> 3 left_shifted  /t/      <dbl [1]>
#> 4 right_shifted /t/      <dbl [1]>
